description: The M11 authentication decision layer (gate M11, M3; audit M11 fix): the §14.9 session-policy floor extended to every principal (30 min idle / 8 h absolute — at least as strict as Origin's), the RFC 6238 TOTP second factor MANDATORY for every approval-capable role (O/SCM/SBR, pinned by parity to the C3 authority), failed-login lockout for all accounts, the password-policy floor over node-native scrypt (the named Argon2id deviation — production credentials live in the OIDC IdP), and the sign-in state machine whose credential step an OIDC assertion replaces without moving anything else. Pure and deterministic — clock, entropy and attempt history are injected. Every invariant decided here is ENFORCED AGAIN at the database (0005_auth: the RESTRICTIVE mfa_gate policy on approval; login_attempt append-only) — the API+DB pair, neither layer trusted alone.
